<div class="card-body">
'''Commander Evram Lajaie''' is a [[Light]] [[Character]] ([[Rebel]]) from [[The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)|The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">イヴラム・ラジャイ少佐</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">ヤヴィン４、ホス、またはエンドアの位置カードに彼が配備されていれば、反乱軍の宇宙船はその星系に“リアクション”として移動できる。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-ESB-Two-Player-Commander-Evram-Lajaie-SWCA-100663.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">宇宙防衛態勢、とりわけ軌道上での戦闘を専門とする著名な<u>リーダー</u>。彼のおかげで、同盟軍はデス・スターの構造上の弱点を発見できた。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Commander Evram Lajaie.

'''Card text:'''
If he is deployed on a Yavin 4, Hoth or Endor location card, Rebel starships may move to that system as a react.

'''Lore:'''
A renowned leader who specializes in space defense, particularly combat in orbit. Thanks to him, the Alliance discovered a structural weakness in the Death Star.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese face says location card rather than site.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Commander Evram Lajaie]] in [[The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 45, 106. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
